propositions: The dedup test suite lacks end-to-end seam-crossing validation: differ tests and apply tests each seed their layer's invariant separately, leaving no control that proves is_comment_mapped guard engagement depends on actual binding store state rather than vacuous behavior
A real envelope posted via the real _record_comment_id path and re-diffed against the same BindingStore instance must skip the recorded comment while still emitting unrecorded control comments
Forcing the BindingStore instance's is_comment_mapped to always return False must re-emit the recorded comment, proving the seam assertion discriminates on the guard rather than passing by default
The test must use the real acli_cli_ops.add_comment and real _diff_comments with a real BindingStore to validate the full apply-to-differ boundary without seeded invariants
